P3_7_sourceManifest.originalReportedClaim: MiniMax reports 38 inconsistencies: five byte differences and 33 paths absent from HEAD; original claim remains untouched.

rawPathAudit.method: git ls-tree -r -z --name-only ce6fd54; decode raw UTF-8 paths; each manifest path resolved by direct argv git show commit:path and its raw blob hashed. No shell filename quoting and no hash of failed-command stdout.

P3_7_sourceManifest.interpretation: Independent raw-path audit reproduces zero missing paths and five differences: approved dirty AGENTS plus four post-manifest documentation edits. It does not reproduce the 33-absent claim and does not establish why the earlier reviewer command differed. local-verification.differences=[] is a historical collection record, not a claim of equality to the later whole frozen tree.
P3_7_sourceManifest.dispositionInThisFile: Provenance cross-reference and factual disagreement supplied for next review; original classification and Not-Pass unchanged.

P3_8_internalReview.explicitOriginalScope: I04 final independent read-only lifecycle/resource review; mutable pre-freeze source
P3_8_internalReview.wholeTreeReconstruction: Unavailable: no contemporaneous full mutable worktree snapshot/manifest or immutable review-subject commit was recorded. observed_git_head identifies the branch tip seen, not the complete reviewed working tree. Eight per-file hashes can be matched to C1; this neither reconstructs all uncommitted files at every probe nor proves C1 was the subject of that earlier internal review.
P3_8_internalReview.dispositionInThisFile: Clarifies scope and unrecoverable historical boundary without inventing a replacement subject SHA, regenerating the old record, or substituting internal review for the original/new external review gates.

Formal ESRCH-specific correction was separately verified; no broad guard suppression was accepted.
